Class MachineEvents

java.lang.Object
fr.robie.machineengine.api.machine.MachineEvents
public final class MachineEvents extends Object
Machine lifecycle and process events (ARCHITECTURE.md §26). All are posted in the EventPhase.POST phase, after the change happened.
